tools.name: tiktok_profile
tools.description: Get a TikTok creator's public profile: follower and following counts, total likes, bio, avatar and verified status. One call returns one profile. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: tiktok_search
tools.description: Search TikTok videos by keyword. One call returns up to 20 videos (up to 50 with count): views, likes, comments, shares, author, caption and hashtags. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: tiktok_videos
tools.description: List a TikTok creator's videos, newest first. One call returns up to 20 videos (up to 50 with count). By username costs 2 credits (one extra profile lookup to resolve the username); by secUid costs 1 credit.

tools.name: tiktok_comments
tools.description: Get the comments on a TikTok video. One call returns up to 20 comments (up to 50 with count): text, author, likes and reply counts. Use this to read buying-intent signals in the buyers' own words, e.g. 'where can I buy this'. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: x_profile
tools.description: Get an X (Twitter) user's public profile: followers, following, bio and verified status. One call returns one profile. Costs 1 credit. Paid plans and pay-as-you-go only — trial keys get an error (the trial is TikTok only).

tools.name: x_search
tools.description: Search X posts by keyword. One call returns up to 20 posts: text, author, likes, reposts, replies and timestamps. Costs 1 credit. Paid plans and pay-as-you-go only — trial keys get an error (the trial is TikTok only).

tools.name: x_posts
tools.description: List an X user's posts, newest first. One call returns up to 20 posts. Costs 1 credit. Paid plans and pay-as-you-go only — trial keys get an error (the trial is TikTok only).

tools.name: x_comments
tools.description: Get the replies to an X post. One call returns up to 20 replies: text, author and engagement. Costs 1 credit. Paid plans and pay-as-you-go only — trial keys get an error (the trial is TikTok only).

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check this API key's plan, credits remaining and trial status (trial end date, days left, whether the trial has started). Free — costs 0 credits. Use it before a batch of calls if you are unsure what the key has left.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tiktok_search, tiktok_comments, x_search, x_posts, x_comments · Private data: check_balance · Public sink: x_comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tiktok_search, tiktok_comments, x_search, x_posts, x_comments · Private data: check_balance · Public sink: x_comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
